summary: Completed comprehensive testing of P0 (MongoDB persistence for connections, templates, scheduled messages) and P1 (message scheduling backend, real-time internal chat). All 23 backend tests passed. All frontend flows working correctly with proper API integration.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/channels/connections returns connections for company
Backend: POST /api/channels/connections creates new WhatsApp connection
Backend: POST /api/channels/connections creates new Instagram connection
Backend: POST /api/channels/connections/{id}/connect sets status to waiting_qr with QR code
Backend: POST /api/channels/connections/{id}/disconnect sets status to disconnected
Backend: DELETE /api/channels/connections/{id} removes connection
Backend: GET /api/channels/templates returns message templates
Backend: POST /api/channels/templates creates/upserts template by process_key
Backend: Template upsert updates existing template with same process_key
Backend: GET /api/channels/scheduled-messages returns scheduled messages
Backend: POST /api/channels/scheduled-messages creates message with status=pendente
Backend: PUT /api/channels/scheduled-messages/{id} updates status (e.g., cancelada)
Backend: GET /api/channels/scheduled-messages?status=cancelada filters by status
Backend: DELETE /api/channels/scheduled-messages/{id} removes message
Backend: GET /api/channels/chat/channels returns or creates default 'general' channel
Backend: GET /api/channels/chat/messages returns chat messages for channel
Backend: POST /api/channels/chat/messages sends message with sender_name
Frontend: ConexoesPage loads connections from API and displays them
Frontend: ConexoesPage 'Canais' tab shows WhatsApp/Instagram connections with status
Frontend: ConexoesPage 'Conectar' button triggers QR code display (waiting_qr status)
Frontend: ConexoesPage 'Mensagens Modelo' tab shows 6 templates with edit buttons
Frontend: ConexoesPage template editing saves to API with 'Modelo salvo!' toast
Frontend: MessageSchedulingPage (Agendamento menu) shows stats and scheduled messages list
Frontend: MessageSchedulingPage 'Agendar Mensagem' modal with recipient/channel/message/datetime fields
Frontend: MessageSchedulingPage creates scheduled message via API with 'Mensagem agendada!' toast
Frontend: MessageSchedulingPage shows 'Cancelar' button for pending messages
Frontend: ChatInternoPage shows channel sidebar with '# Geral' channel
Frontend: ChatInternoPage displays messages with timestamps
Frontend: ChatInternoPage sends messages via API and updates list
Frontend: Chat Interno menu appears in Boss sidebar under OPERACIONAL group
seed_data_creation: Created test data during testing: WhatsApp/Instagram connections, templates, scheduled messages, chat messages (all cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 and P1 features fully implemented and tested. All channel features now persist in MongoDB via /api/channels/* endpoints. ConexoesPage has 2 tabs: Canais (connections with connect/disconnect/delete) and Mensagens Modelo (6 templates with edit). MessageSchedulingPage creates/lists scheduled messages with status management. ChatInternoPage has real-time chat with 5s polling, channel sidebar, and message persistence. Sidebar nav uses data-testid='nav-{key}' format.

mocked_apis.WhatsApp Connection: MOCKED - QR code is simulated, no actual WhatsApp connection
mocked_apis.Message Delivery: MOCKED - scheduled messages are stored but not actually sent

Connections (P0).QR Code: Simulated QR code displayed when connecting
Connections (P0).Persistence: Connections stored in MongoDB channel_connections collection

Message Templates (P0).List: 6 predefined templates (confirmacao, lembrete, cancelamento, boas_vindas, pos_atendimento, aniversario)
Message Templates (P0).Edit: Template message and active status editable
Message Templates (P0).Persistence: Templates stored in MongoDB message_templates collection

Scheduled Messages (P1).Create: Modal with recipient, channel, message, datetime fields
Scheduled Messages (P1).List: Shows all scheduled messages with status badges
Scheduled Messages (P1).Persistence: Messages stored in MongoDB scheduled_messages collection

Internal Chat (P1).Messages: Real-time display with sender name and timestamp
Internal Chat (P1).Send: Messages sent via API and persisted
Internal Chat (P1).Persistence: Messages stored in MongoDB internal_chat collection
